node.description: The node the command ran on.

exitCode.description: The command's exit code; null where the hub reports none.

signal.description: The signal that ended it, or null.

stdout.description: Its standard output as text, its last 64 KiB.

stderr.description: Its standard error as text, its last 64 KiB.

stdoutCut.description: Whether more standard output came than is kept.

stderrCut.description: Whether more standard error came than is kept.
